title.en: Model Adaptation: Fine-Tuning, Distillation and Small Models
title.ar: تكييف النماذج: الضبط الدقيق والتقطير والنماذج الصغيرة

tagline: REPLACE: one line under the title: what participants can do after the course
description: Participants decide when adapting a model is worth it and then do it well. For a fictional chamber of commerce whose bilingual registration requests must stay on its own servers, a prompted small open-weight model fails at field extraction and tool calls. They sort the failures, set a stronger prompted baseline, build a tuning set from traces, staff corrections and filtered teacher outputs, train low-rank adapters, distil a larger model's tool-call behaviour, evaluate against the base and a larger prompted model, and serve the result quantised with several adapters. AE-301 introduces adapters on an encoder; post-training at scale is AE-406.
audience: Practitioners. Engineers who have completed the level 200 set or can show equivalent work: a deployed model or language model application they built and can explain.
prerequisites: AE-202 Deep Learning and Generative AI Fundamentals
AE-203 Building Applications on Language Models
Fine-tunes a pretrained model with a training loop or a training library
Compares two systems on an evaluation set with a paired test

outcomes.text: Analyse the failures of a prompted model and assign each failure class to prompting, retrieval, tuning or distillation, given 100 bilingual requests run through the small model and a larger reference model
outcomes.evidence: a decision table with counts per failure class and the chosen approach

outcomes.text: Prepare a tuning dataset from traces, corrections and teacher outputs, with template rendering, verifier filtering, deduplication, decontamination and personal-data removal, given 500 synthetic traces, staff corrections and a teacher model
outcomes.evidence: a dataset with its card and an overlap report against the test set

outcomes.text: Configure and train low-rank adapters on a 16-bit and a 4-bit base model within the memory of one free-tier GPU, given a small open-weight model and the tuning set
outcomes.evidence: training logs, the adapter and a memory and time comparison

outcomes.text: Evaluate the adapted model against the base and a larger prompted model with paired statistics, language slices, regression and safety checks, given a held-out bilingual test set and a general-ability check
outcomes.evidence: an evaluation report with intervals and the regressions found

outcomes.text: Deploy a quantised small model with several adapters and measure throughput, latency and cost per thousand requests, given one accelerator and a target request rate
outcomes.evidence: a load-test report with the serving configuration

outcomes.text: Decide whether to ship the adapted model, weighing quality, cost, licence terms and data placement, given the evaluation and load-test results
outcomes.evidence: a one-page decision memo defended live
